Patliputra University UG 2nd Merit List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Patliputra University PPUP (Patna, Bihar) has released the 2nd Merit List for the Graduation / Under Graduate/ Degree Course (B.A, B,.Com, B.Sc) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme on the official website of the PPUP. The online application process for Patliputra University PPUP Admission Online Form 2026-30 were accepted from 20 May 2026 to 31 May 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Patliputra University PPUP Admission 2nd Merit Lists 2026-30, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 May 2026
  • Last Date : 31 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 May 2026
  • 1st Merit List Released : 15 June 2026
  • 1st Merit Admission Last Date : 22 June 2026
  • 2nd Merit List Released : 02 July 2026
  • 2nd Merit Admission Last Date : 05 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, BC, EWS : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
